title: Advanced SELECT [JOIN (SELF)]
description:
## SELF JOIN
A self join joins a table with ITSELF. You use table aliases to treat it as two separate tables.

Common use: children and their parents, both stored in the same table.
```sql
SELECT c.name AS child, p.name AS parent
FROM familys as c
INNER JOIN familys AS p
    ON c.parent_id = p.id;
```

## Assignment:
BWS has a staff table where each employee has a manager_id pointing to another employee's id. Show each employee's name and their manager's name.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE staff (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, manager_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO staff VALUES (1, 'CEO Bob', NULL), (2, 'Steve', 1), (3, 'Alice', 1), (4, 'Dave', 2), (5, 'Eve', 2);
